title: Getting started & safety
description: Create your SC Market account, verify your RSI handle, and learn how to trade safely with other players.

title: Buying & price alerts
description: Find items, check out from your cart, post buy orders, get price alerts, and follow an order from offer to delivery.

title: Selling
description: Open a shop, list items for aUEC, manage stock, run auctions, fill buy orders and handle the orders you receive.

title: Orgs: setup & members
description: Register your org, invite members, set up roles and permissions, and keep track of changes in the audit log.

title: Orgs: shop, recruiting & white-label
description: Sell as a team with an org shop, publish a recruiting post, and run a white-label storefront with your own theme.

title: Discord
description: Connect the SC Market bot for order threads, alerts and claiming orders, or post shop events with a webhook.
